title: Poopocalypse
description: Snow Golem Had a Terrible Day.
body:
The Snow Golem was not very lucky.

Instead of being built from snow, he is now crafted from sticks and pure manure. For reasons beyond human understanding, God has decided to punish the world with an endless supply of poop.

Throw poopballs at your enemies, leave a nice brown carpet outside your friend's door, and spread chaos across the land. The Snow Golem has embraced his new destiny, and now it's your turn.

Features:

* Poop Golem
* Poopballs instead of snowballs
* Poop trails instead of snow trails
* More poop than anyone ever asked for
